content:
Claude is upgrading its Chrome sidebar into a full Cowork session, allowing browser tasks and conversations to seamlessly continue in the user's other Claude apps.

Claude can now take browser tasks into all of its apps

Anthropic announced the change today. Conversations initiated in the sidebar will now be saved to the Claude conversation history, where users can pick them up from the Claude desktop, web, and mobile apps.

Skills and connectors configured in an account are now available in the browser without additional setup. Claude in Chrome can read the contents of the current page and perform actions — including clicking links, switching pages, typing text, and filling in forms — through the user's existing browser login sessions.

Anthropic's example is a user asking Claude to gather invoice data from multiple vendor portals, build a spreadsheet, and then continue the same session on the desktop to add local files or compare the results against past budgets.

This update fills a gap in Claude's browser workflow. Previously, sidebar sessions were completely isolated from conversations in Claude's other apps, with no way to share conversation contents or context.

Anthropic recently also showed off an in-app browser for Claude Code, which uses a separate profile. In contrast, the Chrome extension operates on sites where the user is already logged in.

Anthropic warns that browser-based agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks.

Another layer of review will target high-impact actions when auto-approval is enabled, while actions involving purchases or sharing personal data will still require the user's consent.

The company says these safeguards reduce the risk but cannot eliminate it entirely.

Availability

The Cowork sidebar is available starting today for Max and Team customers, with Pro users expected to roll out over the coming weeks. Enterprise admins can enable the feature and restrict access to approved domains. Claude in Chrome does not yet support other Chromium browsers or mobile devices.

The release continues Anthropic's push to make Claude workflows seamless across platforms.

Recent additions include live previews for Claude Code in the Mac iOS app, and new Opus 4.8 controls for running longer jobs across more products and devices.
